title: Fold a travel hair dryer's handle
instruction: Fold the unplugged travel hair dryer's handle fully against its barrel. Leave the dryer resting on the counter with the handle folded, release both hands, and let it settle. The remote part of the cable is already coiled and tied; the loose tail remains attached to the handle. Do not pull or remove the cable.
setup: Stock calibrated bimanual YAM station: unchanged robot bodies, gains, limits and grippers, both at READY. Coordinates x forward, y left, z above the 747.5 mm tabletop; arm bases (0, ±305, 750) mm. Control and 14 joint/jaw targets are 20 Hz; physics is 240 Hz. Policy inputs are three stock 320 × 176 RGB images and 14 measured joint/jaw positions. The cool, unplugged dryer has a 154 × 140 × 79 mm unfolded envelope and 368 g body mass excluding cable/nozzle, based on Panasonic EH-NA2C specifications. Plastic-like barrel and grip bodies are 285 g and 83 g. A metallic-looking pin/eye/clevis surrounds the passive native Y hinge, with a head-local anchor (35,0,-50) mm, 0–90 degree stops and no angle target. The authored barrel origin is (280,-100,45) mm, rolled +90 degrees about X; the unfolded handle origin is (315,-50,45) mm. Free bodies settle during reset; the recorded seed-0 barrel starts near (276.818,-90.463,37.414) mm. Six rubber-like cable capsules, each 50 mm long, radius 2.5 mm and mass 1.25 g, form an attached 300 mm loose tail. Seven native spherical joints connect that tail to a free 68 g tied coil/plug bundle: ring inner/outer radii 30/40 mm, thickness 25 mm, plug 40 × 25 × 18 mm. Its exact reset pose and all six cable poses are generated by layout.RESET_POSES. No body is anchored. Geometry, material contact properties, mass allocation and internal hinge details are engineering estimates. The remote cable is already tied, a storage precondition. This bounded task ends with the folded dryer resting released on the counter; packing a bag is excluded.
scoring: Full score requires the actual handle angle to be 80–93 degrees, the hinge axes and anchor to remain connected, all seven cable joints to remain attached, physical counter support, no robot contact with any device/cable body, low motion, and no more than 0.1 degree hinge drift for a continuous full second sampled at 240 Hz. Partial credit is 0.4 after 45 degrees and 0.7 for the fully folded hinge. Invalid state, separation or leaving the counter permanently voids the episode.
run_limit: 1,000 actions at 20 Hz (50 simulated seconds), physics 240 Hz.
fidelity: Original procedural 154×140×79 mm, 368 g body based on Panasonic EH-NA2C specifications; hinge and component geometry, mass allocation, inertia, friction, bound coil and cable dimensions are engineering estimates. Passive native joints, real collision contacts and massive attached cord are simulated. Unplugged state is a scene precondition. No electrical, thermal or airflow simulation.
scores: Scripted: 2/2 fresh fixed-start trials scored 1.0, 878/1000 actions each. Dream-1 beta: one complete fixed-start trial scored 0.0, 1000/1000 actions; no device contact or folding. Same instruction, scene and scorer; independent audits passed. No official upload or hardware validation.
reset_notes: Single deterministic fixed scene, seed 0. Only reset writes actor transforms and velocities; the initial free device and cable settle naturally. Runtime object transforms, attachment, material, mass and geometry are never changed.
context: Folding a compact hair dryer reduces its volume before drawer or suitcase storage. The bounded mechanical operation ends once the folded device rests released on the counter.
